content:
Micah: quick pass of profiler artifacts from yesterday's continuous-batching sweep: https://perf.redwood/reports/3950001234 - please read the TL;DR at top. thinking we need to adjust max_tokens_per_batch per-cardset rather than a single global value
Anya: reading now. TL;DR looks like KV frag + kernel fallbacks killed packing on H100 when seq > 2k :/
Devon: confirmed. when KV-cache misses spike we see a sharp drop in pack ratio and latency variance increases. observed p95 spikes in the 2-3k token window
Anya: bench summary I extracted (very rough):
```
A10: max_tokens_candidate=4096 -> p50=45ms p95=120ms throughput=9k tok/s pack_ratio=0.82
T4: max_tokens_candidate=2048 -> p50=68ms p95=200ms throughput=4.5k tok/s pack_ratio=0.74
L4: max_tokens_candidate=3072 -> p50=38ms p95=95ms throughput=11k tok/s pack_ratio=0.86
A100: max_tokens_candidate=8192 -> p50=30ms p95=80ms throughput=22k tok/s pack_ratio=0.88
H100: max_tokens_candidate=16384 -> p50=28ms p95=260ms throughput=20k tok/s pack_ratio=0.60 (KV-frag)
```
Devon: the H100 numbers are deceptive: raw throughput good but tail terrible due to kernel fallback + cross-card mem shuffle for long KV extents
Kai: +1 on per-card softcaps. propose softcap + hardcap model: softcap measured as target for pack-formation, hardcap enforced as absolute guard on device. softcap can be adjusted by online signal (pack_ratio, kv-miss-rate)
Micah: makes sense. rough flag idea?
Kai: config patch (proto):
```
max_tokens_per_batch:
  device_defaults:
    A10: {soft: 4096, hard: 6144}
    T4: {soft: 2048, hard: 3072}
    L4: {soft: 3072, hard: 4096}
    A100: {soft: 8192, hard: 12288}
    H100: {soft: 8192, hard: 16384}
  adaptive:
    enabled: true
    signals: [pack_ratio, kv_miss_rate, kernel_fallback_rate]
    min_soft: 1024
    max_soft: device_defaults.hard
```
Anya: I'd cap H100 soft to 8k for now until we fix KV-frag regression. incremental canary: H100 soft=8k, hard=16k for emergency bursts
Devon: also ensure kernel_selector has affinity hint: prefer fused-kernel when pack_ratio < 0.7 to avoid fallback thrash. small change in selector reduces p95 by ~30% in my local tests
Micah: good. perf-bot can you run regression job + canary rollout checklist against staging cardset with these softcaps? job id: batching-tune-3950001234
perf-bot: scheduling job batching-tune-3950001234 on staging cluster. tests: microbench, longseq-flakiness, kv-frag-sim. estimated run time 45m. will post results here when done :robot_face:
Anya: queued manual canary steps: 1) set softcaps in dev config 2) deploy canary to 5% h100 pool 3) monitor pack_ratio, kernel_fallback, p95 4) rollback if p95 > baseline + 25%
Devon: quick note: when you flip adaptive.enabled=true, validate the hysteresis window. we saw oscillation before when adaptive reacted within <30s windows
Kai: will add 2-min smoothing and min-step 10% to avoid oscillation
Micah: ok action items:
- Kai: land config schema + smoothing defaults (PR)
- Anya: run canary + paste perf artifacts here
- Devon: add kernel_selector affinity tweak (small PR)
- Perf-bot: run the scheduled job and report
Micah: thanks team. prefer short canary (1h) then widen if stable. :thumbsup:
